draft.subject: Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE. You work as a robotics engineer there, so you are probably closest to what this role does day to day.

My work has been on the integration side. I built a vision guided robotic arm where a Jetson, an Arduino, a set of ranging sensors on an I2C multiplexer and a mobile app all had to work together, and I fixed a long list of real failures on the way, like servo brownouts and stale camera frames. I have also worked with ROS2 on a physical industrial arm, designed and built circuit boards, and written bare metal firmware for STM32. I like the work where hardware, low level software and field results all meet.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
